Welcome — excited to kick off BrightTech's onboarding. I've attached the onboarding checklist and our standard W9 request (BrightTech_W9.pdf, onboarding-checklist.xlsx). Hi Aditya —

Thanks for the checklist. We uploaded the W9 to your secure intake portal. We did receive the portal invite, but when I clicked it I got an error: "Account mismatch — the email address on the invite (procurement@brighttech.io) does not match the verified domain for our SSO identity (team.brighttech.io)."

We typically use SSO for procurement tools and our IdP enforces exact domain matching — procurement@brighttech.io is a group address that does not have a user account for SAML. Can you resend the invite to my user account: sara.klein@team.brighttech.io? Also, is there a way to bypass the initial link so we can complete the registration manually?

Appreciate the quick help — we have a PO to submit once the account is active.

Best,

Thanks for the flag. Short answer: yes — reissuing directly to sara.klein@team.brighttech.io is the cleanest approach. 

Notes / steps we should follow:
- Reissue invite to the personal SSO-enabled email (Sara). This avoids group alias mismatch errors.
- If the customer needs immediate PO submission, we can provision a temporary manual account (non-SSO) tied to procurement@brighttech.io for a 72-hour window, then deprovision once SSO is validated. This is our standard short-term workaround.
- Require re-upload of W9 to the user account upon first login (audit requirement).
- Rishi — please schedule the re-invite to Ariba (if BrightTech prefers Ariba) or Coupa otherwise. Confirm which portal we should target and include the correct vendor_id BR-4532 in the invitation payload.

I'll include the onboarding checklist and the boilerplate PO acceptance terms that the finance team requires in the invite email. Sara — once you confirm the portal (Ariba/Coupa/Ivalua) and whether you want the temporary manual account, we will proceed.
